cohort: Singleton pregnancies over a six-year period
finding: Obesity was found to be protective against 3rd- and 4th-degree perineal lacerations, independent of parity, race, birth weight, and mode of delivery.
mod_finding: Obesity was protective against 3rd- and 4th-degree lacerations in both spontaneous and operative vaginal deliveries.
birth_weight: Mentioned as a factor considered in the analysis, but specific weight range not provided
